events.description: CIA issued a corrected information report based on a call-in to a U.S. Embassy, claiming a group presently in the United States planned a terrorist operation using high explosives.

The CIA issued a corrected information report, not finally evaluated, on a call-in warning of a group in the US planning a high-explosives terrorist operation. It was disseminated to US agencies including NSA, DIA, State and FBI.

An unnamed person (redacted) called the U.S. Embassy and volunteered that a group in the United States was planning a terrorist operation using high explosives. The exact date and embassy location are redacted.

key_claims: A call-in to a U.S. Embassy volunteered that a group in the United States was planning a terrorist operation involving high explosives.
The report is a corrected version of an earlier report with the same heading and was not finally evaluated intelligence.
The report was distributed widely across US intelligence, military, law enforcement and White House Situation Room addressees.
Names of the group, individuals and the originating embassy are redacted or excised.
